files_or_snippet: CLIBasedTodo.js: fileContents()/writefileContents() JSON read/write pattern (readFileSync + JSON.parse, JSON.stringify + writeFileSync, missing-file fallback)
how_adapted: Only the idea of loading a JSON file if it exists and rewriting it synchronously on each mutation was taken. Rewritten from scratch: the store file is {nextId, items} to keep ids monotonic across removal and reload, writes go through a temp file + rename, and the code is not otherwise copied. Its commander/chalk dependencies and data model were not used.
Inspected as a candidate; not reused. Requires commander and chalk and uses a line-based text file, which does not fit the spec.
